mapper.select: SELECT b.tenant_id::text AS tenantId, a.agent_id::text AS agentId, a.name AS name, a.description AS description, (SELECT count(*) FROM agent_version v WHERE v.agent_id = a.agent_id) AS versionCount, av.version_number AS latestVersionNumber, av.published_at AS latestPublishedAt, d.version AS defVersion, d.lifecycle_state::text AS defLifecycleState, d.roles::text AS defRoles, d.enabled_skills::text AS defEnabledSkills, d.capability_tags::text AS defCapabilityTags, d.overrides::text AS defOverrides, d.model_ref AS defModelRef, d.skill_bundles::text AS defSkillBundles, d.instructions::text AS defInstructions, d.orchestration::text AS defOrchestration, om.mode AS orchestrationMode, COALESCE(tc.tenant_count, 0) AS tenantCount FROM tenant_agent_binding b JOIN agent a ON a.agent_id = b.agent_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT v.version_number, v.published_at FROM agent_version v WHERE v.agent_id = a.agent_id ORDER BY v.version_number DESC LIMIT 1 ) av ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT d.version, d.lifecycle_state, d.roles, d.enabled_skills, d.capability_tags, d.overrides, d.model_ref, d.skill_bundles, d.instructions, d.orchestration FROM cap_agent_def d WHERE d.agent_id = a.agent_id ORDER BY d.version DESC LIMIT 1 ) d ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT CASE WHEN d2.orchestration IS NULL OR d2.orchestration IN ('{}'::jsonb, 'null'::jsonb, '""'::jsonb) OR jsonb_typeof(d2.orchestration) <> 'object' THEN NULL WHEN d2.orchestration ->> 'mode' IS NOT NULL THEN d2.orchestration ->> 'mode' ELSE NULL END AS mode FROM cap_agent_def d2 WHERE d2.agent_id = a.agent_id ORDER BY d2.version DESC LIMIT 1 ) om ON TRUE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT agent_id, count(*) AS tenant_count FROM tenant_agent_binding WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY agent_id ) tc ON tc.agent_id = a.agent_id WHERE b.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (#{tenantIdFilter}::uuid IS NULL OR b.tenant_id = #{tenantIdFilter}::uuid) ORDER BY b.tenant_id, a.name, a.agent_id
